spots.name: Mount Blackburn East Summit
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 4,964 m (16,287 ft).

spots.name: Hanagita Peak
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 2,592 m (8,504 ft).

spots.name: Kuskulana Pass
spots.tip: A mountain pass: easy high ground by car. Fog often fills the valleys on either side at sunrise; check winter road conditions.

spots.name: Leprechaun Cave
spots.tip: A cave entrance. Bring a headlamp and a tripod; light from the opening makes the picture. Check whether it's closed for bats or ice.
